# Per-run LLM call cap

The extractor enforces a hard per-run cap on LLM calls: if calls_made >= max_calls, _complete_cached raises LLMBudgetExceeded and aborts processing for that artifact; completed work remains cached so the run can be resumed later.

Limit and account for LLM usage within a single run to control cost and allow resumable processing when the cap is reached.
